Q953.reason: A unit out of controlled cold storage past the time limit must go back to the blood bank for quarantine or disposal; ward staff must not transfuse it, re-fridge it, or empty it in the sluice.

Q954.reason: Consent, perineal washing, and expiry checks are routine before catheterization; ringing next of kin is not.

Q916.reason: 14–16G cannulae are for rapid volume replacement in trauma or burns, not children, frail elderly veins, or routine hand sites.
